title: Euphorbium
summary: EUPHOR'BIUM, noun [Latin from Gr.] In the materia medica, a gummi-resinous substance, exuding from an oriental tree. It has a sharp biting taste, and is vehemently acrimonious, inflaming and ulceratin

inlines.v: EUPHOR'BIUM, noun [Latin from Gr.] In the materia medica, a gummi-resinous substance, exuding from an oriental tree. It has a sharp biting taste, and is vehemently acrimonious, inflaming and ulcerating the fauces.
